detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN ( 
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS country_count, COUNT(DISTINCT currency) AS currency_count 
  FROM transactions 
  WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
  GROUP BY user_id 
) c ON u.user_id = c.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(u.risk_level) IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND c.country_count >= 2 
AND c.currency_count >= 2 
AND u.user_id IN ( 
  SELECT user_id 
  FROM ( 
    SELECT user_id, instrument, amount_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY amount_usd DESC) AS row_num 
    FROM transactions 
    WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
  ) t 
  WHERE row_num <= 2 
  GROUP BY user_id 
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN instrument IN ( 
    SELECT instrument 
    FROM transactions 
    WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
    GROUP BY instrument 
    HAVING STDDEV(amount_usd) * 100 / SUM(amount_usd) > 10 
  ) THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount_usd) > 0 
) 
AND u.user_id IN ( 
  SELECT user_id 
  FROM ( 
    SELECT user_id, AVG(amount_usd) AS avg_amount_usd, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_amount_usd 
    FROM transactions 
    WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
    GROUP BY user_id 
  ) t 
  WHERE (t.avg_amount_usd - (SELECT AVG(amount_usd) FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days'))) / (SELECT AVG(amount_usd) FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) < 0.2 
)

SELECT DISTINCT u.full_name, u.risk_score, u.risk_level, u.kyc_status, u.kyc_expiry_date, t.instrument, t.amount_usd, t.created_at, t.processed_at 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN ( SELECT user_id, AVG(amount_usd) AS avg_amount_usd, STDDEV(amount_usd) AS std_dev_amount_usd 
       FROM transactions 
       WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
       GROUP BY user_id 
       HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT instrument) >= 2 AND AVG(amount_usd) * 1.25 > ( SELECT AVG(amount_usd) 
                                                                                FROM transactions 
                                                                                WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') AND user_id = u.user_id ) 
     ) AS high_risk_instruments ON u.user_id = high_risk_instruments.user_id 
WHERE u.kyc_status IN ('unverified', 'expiring') AND u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') AND UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%CRYPTO%' OR UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%FOREX%' AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days');

detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_count, 
  COUNT(*) AS total_count, 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t 
  JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
  AND UPPER(u.account_status) = 'ACTIVE' 
GROUP BY 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument 
HAVING 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 > 10 
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) 
       FROM alerts 
       WHERE alerts.user_id = t.user_id 
         AND alerts.severity = 'HIGH' 
         AND alerts.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days')) > 5 
  AND (SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd) 
       FROM transactions t 
       WHERE t.user_id = t.user_id 
         AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
         AND t.instrument = t.instrument) > 250000 
  AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.instrument) 
       FROM transactions t 
       WHERE t.user_id = t.user_id 
         AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) >= 2 
  AND (SELECT STDDEV(SUM(t.amount_usd)) 
       FROM transactions t 
       WHERE t.user_id = t.user_id 
         AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) > 0.15 * (SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd) 
                                                                 FROM transactions t 
                                                                 WHERE t.user_id = t.user_id 
                                                                   AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days'))

  FROM transactions t 
  GROUP BY user_id 
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT instrument) >= 2 AND AVG((SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM transactions WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') AND instrument = t.instrument) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM transactions WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND created_at >= date('now', '-90 days'))) > 0.1
) p ON u.user_id = p.user_id 
JOIN (
  SELECT user_id, AVG((SELECT amount_usd FROM transactions WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND created_at >= date('now', '-30 days'))) AS avg_amount, 
         (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM transactions WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')) AS total_amount 
  FROM transactions 
  GROUP BY user_id 
  HAVING AVG((SELECT amount_usd FROM transactions WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND created_at >= date('now', '-30 days'))) * 1.2 > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM transactions WHERE user_id = u.user_id AND created_at >= date('now', '-30 days'))
